marketing.ttl: 迪士尼米奇进上海网球大师赛，三年战略合作启动
marketing.sum: 迪士尼中国与久事动娱启动三年战略合作，米奇以网球主题形象亮相2026上海劳力士大师赛，联名产品、快闪空间与'大师赛+迪士尼乐园'联票同步上线，IP联名从娱乐场走进体育场。
marketing.body: 米奇打进网球大师赛：迪士尼中国与久事动娱启动三年战略合作，首个项目落地2026上海劳力士大师赛(10月5-18日)，米奇将以网球主题形象亮相，联名产品、快闪空间和'大师赛+迪士尼乐园'联票同步上线。IP联名从娱乐场，走进体育场。

marketing.ttl: 瑞幸联名名创优品YOYO，半年狂卖5亿的'长公主'成流量新宠
marketing.sum: 瑞幸与名创优品旗下现象级IP'YOYO'联名新品9月7日上线，两款联名咖啡配全套杯具周边；流量越来越贵，品牌开始为'身份'和'场景'买单。
marketing.body: 瑞幸联名'狂魔'再出手：与名创优品旗下现象级IP'YOYO'的联名新品9月7日上线，两款联名咖啡配全套杯具周边。半年狂卖5亿的'长公主'，成了瑞幸的流量新宠。

marketing.ttl: 鹿晗官宣拓路者首位全球代言人，户外赛道从'卷功能'卷到'卷代言人'
marketing.sum: 国货户外品牌拓路者官宣鹿晗为首位全球代言人，冲锋衣海报一出直接刷屏，9月7-13日限定周边跟上。户外赛道从'卷功能'卷到'卷代言人'。
marketing.body: 拓路者官宣鹿晗为首位全球代言人：国货户外品牌冲顶流，冲锋衣海报一出直接刷屏，9月7-13日限定周边跟上。户外赛道从'卷功能'卷到'卷代言人'。

marketing.ttl: 立白第九届9月9感恩欢购节，迪丽热巴升级全球代言人引爆品效
marketing.sum: 第五届立白9月9感恩欢购节总曝光超100亿人次，TVC首登央视超63亿人次，天猫超品日销售破100%；迪丽热巴由代言人升级为全球代言人，从'产品出海'走向'品牌出海'。
marketing.body: 截至发稿，第五届立白9月9感恩欢购节总曝光已超100亿人次、TVC首登央视总曝光超63亿人次、天猫超品日全场销售超额突破100%并斩获洗护品类TOP1。迪丽热巴由品牌代言人升级为'立白品牌全球代言人'，立白从'产品出海'走向'品牌出海'。

marketing.ttl: 9月全球社媒趋势：怀旧档案、反精致与圣诞前置
marketing.sum: 9月TikTok/Instagram趋势：超具体幽默、反精致内容、小胜利格式、早圣诞种草；品牌应'翻自家档案'做怀旧，而非追热点。Fashion Month、90s/00s怀旧与圣诞发现季同步升温。
marketing.body: September sees a move towards hyper-specific humour, ordinary and anti-aspirational content, small-win formats (Gold Star Behaviour, 'lock in'), and stronger opinion or problem-led hooks. Fashion Month, Practical Magic 2, 90s/00s nostalgia and early Christmas shopping all shape social content. Brands should look at what they already own before manufacturing a new nostalgia campaign — old adverts, packaging, discontinued products can become social content.

tech.ttl: OpenAI牵手三星造芯，智元发布AGILE2.0感控一体模型
tech.sum: OpenAI与三星在下一代芯片研发与联合生产取得最大进展；智元发布AGILE2.0，把人形机器人运动控制从分段式推向端到端'边看边想边动'。
tech.body: NO.1 OpenAI牵手三星造芯：9月9日OpenAI韩国总经理表示与三星电子在下一代芯片研发与联合生产方面取得最大进展。NO.2 智元发布AGILE2.0感控一体模型：人形机器人运动控制尝试告别机械'盲动'，开始'边看、边想、边动'。

tech.ttl: OpenAI称破解纳维-斯托克斯千年难题，Meta推首款个人智能体Muse
tech.sum: OpenAI称用内部模型解决纳维-斯托克斯存在性与光滑性难题；推出图像模型ChatGPT Images 2.5；Meta推出可自主完成邮件、预订等任务的首款个人智能体Muse。
tech.body: OpenAI称使用内部模型破解千禧年大奖难题之一——纳维-斯托克斯存在性与光滑性问题，生成解析证明和Lean形式化验证。OpenAI推出图像生成模型ChatGPT Images 2.5，面向所有ChatGPT用户开放。Meta推出首款个人智能体Muse，可主动帮助用户实现目标并提出建议，初期仅向美国用户开放。

tech.ttl: 2026外滩大会开幕：当智能体成为交易主体，先解安全与信任
tech.sum: 2026 Inclusion·外滩大会以'共创AI新经济'为主题开幕。蚂蚁CEO韩歆毅指出智能体供需两端尚未形成正循环，蚂蚁角色是'催化剂'：解安全信任、推生态飞轮。
tech.body: 9月10日，2026 Inclusion·外滩大会以'共创AI新经济'为主题开幕。蚂蚁集团CEO韩歆毅表示，许多商家希望参与智能体经济但仍在探索如何把自身服务转化为可被智能体调用和完成的能力，目前整个智能体供需两端尚未形成正循环。韩歆毅将蚂蚁在智能体爆发前夜的角色概括为'催化剂'：一是解决安全和信任问题；二是推动智能体供需生态飞轮的形成。

tech.ttl: Google DeepMind发布AlphaGenome Atlas，绘制90亿DNA变异影响
tech.sum: Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，可检索人类基因组全部90亿个单字母DNA改变预测的分子效应，1PB数据集含AVI评分，开放Web/API/Google Antigravity。
tech.body: Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable database mapping the predicted molecular effects of all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes in the human genome. The 1-petabyte dataset includes the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score to rank mutation effects. Access is available via a web portal, API, and Google Antigravity.

tech.ttl: Runway上架Adobe插件，Suno推出v6音乐模型，AI创作工具密集更新
tech.sum: Runway推出Premiere Pro/After Effects免费插件，AI生成/编辑/放大直插时间线；Suno发布v6模型家族（v6/v6-wild/v6-mini），音乐生成更精准。长视频一致性与角色连贯仍是规模化试金石。
tech.body: Runway launched free plugins for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, integrating AI generation, editing, and upscaling directly into the timeline. Suno introduced its v6 model family with three versions built with artists and producers; v6-mini is available to all accounts including Free tier. For the industry, long-video consistency, character coherence and cost remain the touchstones of scaled adoption.

daily.ttl: 习近平向全国教师致以教师节祝贺
daily.sum: 第四十二个教师节之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，强调为党育人、为国育才。
daily.body: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平代表党中央，向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。习近平强调，新征程上，希望广大教师牢记为党育人、为国育才的初心使命。

daily.body: 人力资源社会保障部等部门日前向社会发布船舶岸基管理工程技术人员、具身智能机器人应用技术员、运动数据分析师等11个新职业，社区工作者、低空物流员、适老化改造设计师等23个新工种，调整变更农产品经纪人等6个职业（工种）信息。

听.title: BBC 6 Minute English — Scared of speaking English?
听.body:
Pippa: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Pippa.
Beth: And I'm Beth. Have you ever been scared of speaking in English? In this episode, we're talking about why speaking in a different language can be so stressful.
Hanan (BBC Arabic / Beating Speaking Anxiety): My English was actually pretty good but having conversations with people, I found it really difficult. When I first joined the BBC, the Learning English team made an assessment of my English level... My results were pretty good and I was fluent. But on that very same day, leaving the building and going to get some coffee, I couldn't really understand what the barista was saying, and I felt pretty nervous to order coffee.
Georgie: Hanan's experience is something that lots of people can relate to.
Pippa: Lots of people feel nervous speaking another language, even if they're good at it. We can call this speaking anxiety. Anxiety means an uncomfortable feeling or worry about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
听.zh: 本期聊'说外语为何紧张'：即使英语不错，点咖啡时仍会焦虑。关键词 pretty（相当）、relate to（有共鸣）、anxiety（焦虑）、self-perception（自我认知）。练习：用英语说说你学外语时最怕的场景。

说.title: Daily speaking prompt — Describe a product you love
说.body: Talk for 1-2 minutes about a product or brand you genuinely love. Explain: what it is, why you like it, and one way its marketing made you notice it. Try to use 2-3 descriptive adjectives and one 'because' clause. Record yourself and listen for filler words (um, like, you know).
说.zh: 口语话题：用1-2分钟介绍一个你真心喜欢的产品/品牌。说什么、为什么喜欢、它的营销如何让你注意到它。试着用2-3个形容词和至少一个 because 从句；录下来听自己的口头禅。

读.title: AI-powered retail driving consumption
读.body:
As China doubles down on expanding domestic demand, the next wave of consumption growth is being driven by artificial intelligence-powered retail and a rapid diversification of service sectors, analysts and executives said.
Final consumption expenditure contributed 52 percent to China's economic growth in 2025, cementing its role as the primary engine of the world's second-largest economy.
'AI agents are increasingly taking over consumer decision-making processes, from discovery to comparison to purchase,' said Alfred Yin of EY Greater China, adding that early adopters of AI-driven interaction channels are reporting conversion rates that significantly outperform traditional pathways.
PwC estimates that China's AI-driven e-commerce market will exceed 800 billion yuan ($117 billion) in 2026, with segments such as smart customer service and personalized recommendations growing at over 30 percent annually.
读.zh: 文章主题：AI驱动零售正重塑消费。2025年最终消费支出对经济增长贡献52%；AI智能体正接管'发现—比价—购买'决策链条；普华永道预计2026年中国AI电商市场超8000亿元。适合积累商业/营销英语：domestic demand（内需）、conversion rates（转化率）、personalized recommendations（个性化推荐）。

写.title: Daily writing task — A short brand story
写.body: Write 80-120 words telling the 'story' of a small everyday brand (a cafe, a stationery shop, a local bakery). Focus on: who it serves, what makes it different, and the feeling it creates. Avoid hard-sell words; show, don't tell.
写.zh: 写作任务：写80-120词，讲述一个日常小品牌（咖啡馆/文具店/面包房）的'故事'。聚焦：服务谁、有何不同、营造什么感受。避免硬广词，用 show don't tell。

练.title: Vocabulary & grammar drill — Collocations with 'growth / trust / experience'
练.body:
Match and make sentences:
1) build / earn / lose -- _____ trust
2) drive / sustain / unlock -- _____ growth
3) gain / share / design -- _____ experience
Write three sentences, one for each pair, using the collocation naturally. Example: 'A brand earns trust by keeping small promises consistently.'
练.zh: 词汇/语法：搭配练习。trust 可与 build/earn/lose 搭配；growth 可与 drive/sustain/unlock 搭配；experience 可与 gain/share/design 搭配。各写一句自然英文，如 'A brand earns trust by keeping small promises.'
